records.region: Northwestern Nicaragua: Malpaisillo–Olomega-side headward corridor, Estero Real lowlands and lower estuarine channel in the Golfo de Fonseca setting.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Representative identity of the connected selected system, including an Olomega-side headward tributary corridor and the named Estero Real lower river and tidal estuary. Río Olomega is retained as a distinct upper-reach name, not as a whole-system alias. Tecomapa is a separately mapped joining drainage; its name is not imposed on this southern selected opening.
records.completion_scope: Both mainstem fragments, all 36 stored parts, the chosen southern opening, intermediate agricultural-valley and confluence settings, middle floodplain/wetland passage, pond-lined estuarine bends, fragment join and actual final lower-estuary endpoint have correspondence at ordinary corridor scale. No additional lake or reservoir passage is selected. No exact banks, present wetted thread, hydraulic operation or extension beyond the supplied endpoint is asserted.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative identity of the connected selected system, including an Olomega-side headward tributary corridor and the named Estero Real lower river and tidal estuary. scope_limits: Formal official-name registry status, exact hydronym transition points and an official source/mouth coordinate remain unverified.

The selected terminal is inside the broad lower Estero Real estuarine water. Regional connection to Golfo de Fonseca does not authorize extending the stored endpoint.

Historical maps and mixed-date imagery establish ordinary geographic correspondence, not perennial discharge, exact banks, present water extent or operation of adjacent agricultural/aquaculture works.

scope_limits: Río Chancay-Huaral is a representative system identity supported by direct river labels, not an accepted scalar natural name assigned to every upstream tributary, lake or managed structure.

Regional/cartographic generalization, imagery mosaic seams and seasonal channel appearance do not establish current banks, discharge, reservoir operations or a present open-mouth condition.

Two optional primary publications are unavailable at their exact scopes. Neither is necessary for the completed ordinary geographic correspondence supplied by the own SENAMHI maps and successful imagery.

publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
